title: Victory Counter
description: Shared, always-visible tracks for any game system. Progress tracks count up to a target and complete there. Threshold tracks start at a value the GM sets, move up and down, and take their meaning from GM-described bands that can announce themselves in chat when crossed. Step tracks count to a target as a row of discrete steps, up to ten of which the GM can name so the clock announces the moments that matter. Every player sees the same live state on screen. System-agnostic: the module stores its entire state in its own settings and never reads or writes any world document.
